name: 51247 · Rock Valley, IA
findings: ZIP 51247 (Rock Valley) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51247 (Rock Valley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51247 (Rock Valley) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
